annotations.title: Estimate a property's sale value and rent

description: Market estimate for one described home in a Spanish municipality: an estimated sale value and an estimated monthly rent (single figures), each with its range, confidence, sources and the main factors, plus the free full report for the property (selling taxes, net rental return), from current comparable listings (idealista, fotocasa, pisos.com). An estimate, not an official appraisal (tasación). The street or area narrows the range; without it the range is wide and the confidence low. A new valuation takes about 20 to 40 seconds; the same property asked again within 30 days answers at once. En español: valoración de una vivienda, cuánto vale mi piso, precio de venta y alquiler estimado.

condition.description: to_renovate, needs_updates, good (move-in ready) or renovated (recently).

features.description: Optional: e.g. terrace, lift, garage, pool, sea views.

place_id.description: The municipality's place id from find_place.

property_type.description: flat, penthouse, house (detached), townhouse or studio.

street_or_area.description: Optional: street, neighbourhood or area within the municipality.
